questions.stem: Researchers want to assess association between consumption of OCP and incidence of stroke. For this purpose studies were conducted in Delhi and Mumbai. Study A, which was conducted in Delhi, reports RR of 1.4 (95% CI 0.9-2.1) among women consuming OCPs and Study B from Mumbai reports RR of 1.3 (95% CI 1.2-1.5) among women consuming OCPs. Which of the following best describes about the studies?

options.label: A
options.text: Sample size is more in study A

options.label: B
options.text: Sample size is less in study A

options.label: C
options.text: P value for study B is 0.05

options.label: D
options.text: Results in study B are not accurate
